competences.description: Attacks with a spinning punch and stuns the enemy for 1 turn with a 50% chance.

effets.description: The target will be stunned and won't be able to attack.

competences.description: Launches 2 consecutive attacks on an enemy, inflicting damage and absorbing the enemy's Attack Bar by 25% with each attack.
The critical rate will be at 100% if the enemy has no harmful effects. Attacks the target one more time with [Energy Punch] when you attack with a critical hit on your turn. [Automatic Effect]
